title: Introduce credential-allocator and rewrite pullstream ergonomics across Py/TS/Go SDKs
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Adds a cross-SDK credential allocator to centralize TTL bookkeeping and introduce a simpler pullstream API. Surface-level ergonomics fixes for Python/TS/Go; minor version bumps for all three SDKs. No breaking changes for existing APIs; opt-in via new factories and config.
description:
Context: multiple upstream incidents and UX reports showed duplicated TTL logic and fragile reauth handling inside each SDK's streaming facades. This PR introduces a cross-language 'credential allocator' concept: a small local library that centralizes lease bookkeeping, prefetch strategies, and backoff presets so SDK streaming facades can rely on a single, tested policy instead of bespoke copies.

What this PR does (single-string summary): Implements credential-allocator in Go/TS/Python, rewrites the pullstream/pull-generator helpers to call into the allocator, adds a lightweight polling-based lease refresher (with optional heartbeat integration), and introduces explicit ergonomic factories (CredentialAllocatorFactory, PullstreamBuilder) to simplify consumer code and make safe default retry profiles the standard. Also bumps SDK package versions: py-sdk 1.14.0 -> 1.15.0, ts-sdk v2.7.3 -> v2.8.0, go-sdk v0.9.6 -> v0.10.0.

Motivation: reduce duplicated code, eliminate subtle race windows on reauth, and provide predictable retry/backoff defaults tuned for our hosted service latency envelope. This makes it easier for engineers to adopt streaming features without custom credential plumbing.

Compatibility and opt-in: All changes are additive. Existing streaming entrypoints are retained and delegated to the new builders internally. Customers that used private credential hooks continue to work; new factory APIs are recommended for new integrations and will be the default in next major SDK release.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement credential allocator core (py/ts/go)
- [x] Expose ergonomic factories and builders
- [x] Add comprehensive unit tests for TTL transitions and failover
- [x] End-to-end smoke in CI against staging gateway
- [x] Documentation examples for migration and new idioms

Rollout plan: Feature-flagged in SDKs for one release; release notes call out recommended migration path. Coordinate with platform to monitor token-refresh SLO and increase sampling of streaming traces for two weeks.

Notes: This is intentionally conservative about automatic behavioral changes; allocator defaults mirror existing best-practices (small prefetch window, jittered TTL refresh, circuit breaker threshold aligned to current endpoints).
commit_summary: 3 logical commits: 1) credential-allocator core + tests (py/ts/go) 2) pullstream/pull-generator rewrite and SDK facades wired to allocator; versions bumped 3) docs, examples, and release notes. Commit messages include short reproducer in python for a prior race-condition. Some internal helper files moved to common/internal/allocator in redwood repo to avoid duplication.
files_changed: redwood/sdk-python/src/redwood/allocator.py (new), redwood/sdk-python/src/redwood/pullstream.py (rewrite), redwood/sdk-python/setup.cfg (version bump), redwood/sdk-typescript/src/allocator/index.ts (new), redwood/sdk-typescript/src/pullstream/adapter.ts (rewrite), redwood/sdk-typescript/package.json (version bump), redwood/sdk-go/allocator/allocator.go (new), redwood/sdk-go/pullstream/stream.go (rewrite), redwood/sdk-go/go.mod (version bump), docs/sdk/migration/credential-allocator.md (new), examples/py/pullstream-allocator-example.py (new), examples/ts/pullstream-allocator-example.ts (new), tests/* (unit/e2e additions). High level: moved duplicated TTL bookkeeping from three places into the allocator packages and replaced ad-hoc reauth timers with allocator-owned leases.

Notable: initial integration run timed out on a staging token refresh scenario — added extra retries and increased wait timeout in the integration harness and re-ran; subsequent runs green.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash merge by Priya Raman on 2026-02-05 (merge commit: 9c5b2a2). Release artifacts: py-sdk 1.15.0 wheel published, ts-sdk v2.8.0 npm release staged, go-sdk v0.10.0 tagged. Post-merge: started platform SLO monitor job and smoke tests as part of rollout checklist.
migration_notes: Migration is straightforward: replace direct token-refresh hooks with CredentialAllocatorFactory() in new code. Existing code continues to function. See docs/sdk/migration/credential-allocator.md for pattern and diagnostics commands to verify lease heartbeats and prefetch behavior.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for TTL boundary transitions, mocked heartbeat injection, and simulated auth-server 500s to ensure backoff and circuit open behavior. End-to-end smoke validates token swap without dropped bytes in the pullstream flow.
